The '''1979 Danish 1st Division''' season was the 34th season of the [[Danish 1st Division]] league championship, governed by the [[Danish Football Association]]. It constituted the 66th edition of the [[Danish football champions]]hip, and saw [[Esbjerg fB]] win the championship title.

The Danish champions qualified for the [[European Cup 1980-81]], while the second placed teams qualified for the [[UEFA Cup 1980-81]]. The three lowest placed teams of the tournament were directly [[Promotion and relegation|relegated]] to the [[Danish 2nd Division]] for the following season. Likewise, the Danish 2nd Division champions and two first runners-up were [[Promotion and relegation|promoted]] to the 1st Division.
